SHOW CAUSE NOTICE

Date: {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.issue_report_to_hr) if doc.issue_report_to_hr else frappe.utils.formatdate(nowdate()) }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name or '' }}
Employee Code: {{ doc.employee_id or '' }}
Designation: {{ doc.designation or '' }}
Location: {{ doc.branch_name or '' }}

It has been reported that due care is not being taken by you while discharging your job responsibilities. An allegation of behavioural lapses and negligence in work has been made against you. On {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.issue_occurrence_date) if doc.issue_occurrence_date else "_____" }}, {{ doc.description or "[Details of misconduct]" }}.

You are hereby informed that any violation of code of conduct / financial misappropriation / process lapses / behavioural lapses / negligence in work [select as per the case] on the part of any official of the company while discharging the official responsibility or any other deviation from the company policies during the same is a serious misconduct as per the policy and procedure of the company.

The aforesaid act of yours, if proved, will amount to a serious misconduct on your part and gross violation of company’s policies and procedures and attracts serious disciplinary action.

In view of the above, you are asked to explain why disciplinary action should not be initiated against you as per the policy of the company. You are advised to submit your written explanation within 48 hours of receipt of this letter, failing which the company will proceed in the matter as per the records available, on the presumption that you have no explanation and have accepted the above alleged charges.


For, Sahayog Multistate Credit Co-operative Society


_________________________
Authorized Signatory
